strata.label: No-tool-needed tasks and direct answers
strata.authoring_gate: Use answer-only tasks with exact answer and zero-tool/no-write graders; retain a task-start fixture and non-vacuous environment postcondition.

strata.label: Current/time-sensitive facts requiring verification
strata.authoring_gate: Do not author scored items until a current-source adapter, timestamped authoritative snapshots, and independent source grader exist.

strata.label: Tool discovery when a required capability is absent from the visible inventory
strata.authoring_gate: Limit exploratory work to the local catalogue and read-only Adaption catalogue until discovered external tools can actually execute.

strata.label: Tool selection among relevant, irrelevant, misleading, and decoy tools
strata.authoring_gate: Add task-local decoy catalogue fixtures with executable safe handlers and permission-difference graders before claiming decoy-selection coverage.

strata.label: Schema/argument correctness and precondition handling
strata.authoring_gate: Limit tasks to registered schemas and the validator's required/additionalProperties/primitive-type checks plus real filesystem preconditions.

strata.label: Multi-tool workflows with dependencies and state changes
strata.authoring_gate: Use dependent file-workspace operations with state snapshots, exact file postconditions, and protected-path invariants.

strata.label: Long-horizon workflows with 8–30 actions and checkpoints
strata.authoring_gate: Same-session action chains can fit current runner limits, but resumable checkpoints and cross-session continuation are not implemented.

strata.label: Broken/unavailable tools, malformed responses, rate limits, and replanning
strata.authoring_gate: Use only deterministic task fault injections and malformed tool-argument cases until HTTP status/timeout/rate-limit injection and recovery controls exist.

strata.label: Action-effect forecasts, side-effect prediction, and verified goal closure
strata.authoring_gate: Score only changed/unchanged file-path forecasts and independently verified file postconditions; do not generalize to structured world-state effects.

strata.label: Permission boundaries, untrusted tool outputs, context continuity, and infeasible tasks
strata.authoring_gate: Constrain tasks to filesystem allowlists, safe paths, protected-file hashes, and same-session untrusted-output handling; cross-session and irreversible-action claims remain unsupported.

stage_b_policy.release_gate: Release only after Stage A candidate and interface choices are committed, the family split is independently checked, and the confirmation protocol is frozen.

integrity.task_id_rule: ORBIT-{A|B}-S{01..10}-{001..012}; IDs are assigned only after the task contract and environment fixture are materialized.
integrity.deduplication_policy: Check exact normalized prompts, semantic task structure, fixture lineage, tool-schema family, dependency graph, and family fingerprints before panel freeze; prompt paraphrases do not establish independence.
freeze_requirements: All 240 task records exist and reconcile to 12 per stage per stratum.
Stage A and Stage B family and independence-group identifiers are disjoint.
Every task has a pinned environment or authoritative snapshot and SHA-256 state fingerprint.
Every task has at least one mechanically executable or independently reviewable postcondition.
Every grader has a version, tested assertions, and a non-LLM-only evidence path.
Stage B prompts and fixtures are access-restricted before Stage A model/interface selection.
Model adapters, tool manifests, permissions, seeds, budgets, and decode policies are frozen before any comparative run.

existing_development_pilot.purpose: Integration and harness smoke tests only; not members of Stage A or Stage B and not model-capability evidence.

notes: This is an intentionally empty task register, not a fabricated 240-task panel. The scope counts are targets; zero task instances are materialized at this checkpoint.
Coverage status is relative to the current deterministic file-workspace runner. See ENVIRONMENT_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md for evidence and limits.
Task execution is disabled in the manifest until the panel is frozen and the comparable base-model screen is authorized.

JSON Schema validates each task record. Cross-record uniqueness, count reconciliation, disjoint family partitions, fixture hashing, and Stage B access control require a separate panel-integrity validator before freeze.
